items.text: After class 8 there is no stream to choose yet, so the useful work is building strong basics in language, maths and science, trying many activities to see what interests the child, and keeping the next two years open for informed decisions at class 10.
Strengthen reading, writing and maths, explore two or three interests through clubs and projects, and delay hard career decisions until class 10.
Check the school and official board notices for current information.
